content: {"question":"If a GitLab employee is moving from Canada to New Zealand, how does the coverage for pre‑existing conditions differ between the two countries’ plans?","answer":"In Canada, pre‑existing conditions are covered immediately upon enrollment, whereas in New Zealand pre‑existing conditions are covered only if the employee enrolls within 90 days of the start date.","evidence_a":"- [FAQs Health Benefits](https://www.manulife.ca/personal/support/group-plans/group-benefits/faqs.html)","evidence_b":"- **Pre‑existing conditions:** Immediate cover if enrolled within 90 days of start date"}
